description: The talking points of one card, computed from the record: title fights and title eliminators, the closest bout by UFCalendar's model, rematches and trilogy deciders, who is on a streak, who is debuting or returning from a long layoff, the ranked fighters and champions on the card, nations represented, the tallest and longest-reach fighters and the fastest career finish on the bill.
name: get_event_storylines
title: Get event storylines
